REPORT ON Chinese Distress Relief Society. 中國濟難會
Made by C.D.I. Givens Forwarded by
Sir,
One of the most important Communist organizations
in Shanghai is the Chinese Distress Relief Society, No. 31
San Foong Li (三丰里), Tien Tung An Road (天通庵路), Chapei,
which has branches in Peking, Canton and Swatow. A circular
issued by this society when its local branch was formed in
October 1925 stated that as many of those engaged in the popular
fight for freedom are bound to fall victims to the attacks
of their numerous external and internal enemies before the
goal is reached, it is necessary to have an association which will
afford relief to all persons of practical value who suffer in
this way. These sentiments and the fact that similar movements
took place in various other parts of the world about the same
time indicate that the formation of the Society resulted from
resolutions adopted by the 4th and 5th Congresses of the
Communist International where it was clearly indicated that
these societies are not charitable institutions, but have
been organized to form part of the line of defence of the
Red International by the M.O.P.R. (International Red Aid to
Revolutionists) which is affiliated to the 3rd International.
Activities of a public nature of the local branch of the Chinese
Distress Relief Society comprise :
(1) Assisting extremist agitators under trial or in prison.
(2) Promotion of Public demonstrations likely to serve as
propaganda for the furtherance of extremist views.
(3) Collection of funds for the assistance of agitators brought
into trouble by their subversive activities.

关于中国济难会的报告。
由 C.D.I. Givens 制作，呈送
先生，
上海最重要的共产党组织之一是位于闸北天通庵路三丰里31号的中国济难会，该会在北京、广州和汕头设有分会。该会地方分会于1925年10月成立时发布的一份通告指出，由于许多投身于争取自由的民众斗争的人在达到目标之前，难免成为众多内外敌人攻击的牺牲品，因此有必要建立一个协会，为所有在此类斗争中遭受苦难且具有实际价值的人士提供救济。这些言论以及当时世界各地出现类似运动的事实表明，该会的成立源于共产国际第四次和第五次代表大会通过的决议，会上明确指出，这些协会并非慈善机构，而是由隶属于第三国际的国际革命战士救济会（M.O.P.R.，即 International Red Aid to Revolutionists）组织起来，作为红色国际防线的一部分。
中国济难会地方分会的公开活动包括：
(1) 协助正在受审或入狱的极端分子煽动者。
(2) 推动可能作为宣传手段以推进极端主义观点的公众示威活动。
(3) 为因颠覆活动而陷入困境的煽动者募集资金。

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No 7232
Date 28/7/26

MEMORANDUM.

Chinese Distress Relief Association.

1) As the result of the decision taken by the Chinese
Communist Party steps were taken in October 1925 to establish a
"Chinese Distress Relief Association". (中國濟難會 ) in Shang-
hai. Branches of the same association have been formed in Peking,
Canton and Swatow, and other branches are in formation.

2) The following extract from a printed leaflet circulated
in Shanghai shows that the organisation is to all intents and pur-
poses a branch of the "I.O.P.R. (International Red Aid to Revolution-
ists), which is affiliated to the Third International, and this con-
clusion is made more certain by the quotation which appears in para.
4 below:

"Large numbers of persons have been killed, wounded or
imprisoned in different places as a result of the May 30th
incident and there are bound to be numerous other victims in
the future in our popular fight for liberty, as our enemies
external and internal are so numerous. These persons sacrifice
themselves for their country and for society and do not expect
outside assistance. But Socialists must not look on unmoved at
the difficulties and sufferings of them and their dependents
and that is what has moved us to promote this Association.
Associations similar to this have been formed in various --
countries, e.g. Germany has its "Aid Association", England its
"International Revolutionary Prisoners Aid Society", Russia,
France, Italy and the Balkans have their "International Red
Aid" Societies, and the United States their "International
Labour Defence League".

The object of all these is not only to help those who are
in trouble and their dependents, but also to promote friendly
feelings and co-operation among the oppressed races and --
oppressed classes throughout the world. These Associations
came into being because, as a result of the rise of the struggle
for liberty in the industrial and colonial countries after the
European war, many hundreds of thousands of workers and peasants
were killed, and the prisons of many countries were filled to
overflowing with political prisoners. All these victims of the
struggle, though treated by the government of the day as crimi-
nals, are really the soldiers of the social war, and some even
the future pillars of the state, as e.g. the Meiji reformers
in Japan, and the Soviet leaders, who by former governments
were either imprisoned or put to death. Therefore the bringing
of aid to political offenders who suffer injury, imprisonment
or death is not only a manifestation of human sympathy, but
also is of practical value as defending men of value to the
country and to society.

Fut

刑事调查科 (C. I. D.)
I. O. REG
编号 7232
日期 1926年7月28日

备忘录。

中国济难会。

1) 由于中国共产党作出的决定，1925年10月在上海采取了建立“中国济难会”的步骤。该协会的分会已在北京、广州和汕头成立，其他分会也在组建中。

2) 以下摘录自上海流传的一份印刷传单，显示该组织实际上就是“国际革命战士救济会”（I.O.P.R.，International Red Aid to Revolutionists）的一个分支，后者隶属于第三国际。下文第4段中的引文使这一结论更加确凿：

“由于五卅事件，各地有大量人员被杀、受伤或监禁，而在我们争取自由的民众斗争中，由于内外敌人众多，未来必然会有更多受害者。这些人为国家和社会牺牲自己，并不期望外界援助。但社会主义者不能对他们的困难及其家属的苦难无动于衷，这正是我们要推动建立该协会的原因。各国已建立了类似的协会，例如德国有其‘援助协会’，英国有其‘国际革命囚犯援助社’，俄国、法国、意大利和巴尔干地区有其‘国际红色救济’协会，美国有其‘国际劳工保卫联盟’。

所有这些组织的目的不仅在于帮助那些陷入困境的人及其家属，还在于促进全世界被压迫民族和被压迫阶级之间的友好感情与合作。这些协会之所以产生，是因为欧洲战争后，工业国家和殖民地的自由斗争兴起，导致数十万工人和农民被杀，许多国家的监狱中政治犯人满为患。所有这些斗争的受害者，虽然被当时的政府视为罪犯，但实际上是社会战争的士兵，有些人甚至是未来的国家栋梁，例如日本的明治维新改革者和苏联领导人，他们曾被前政府监禁或处决。因此，向遭受伤害、监禁或死亡的政治犯提供援助，不仅是人类同情的表现，而且具有保护对国家和社会有价值人士的实际价值。

Fut

page_data.en:
-2-

But this is a task which cannot be undertaken only by
organisations which are small in numbers or resources, and
it needs a wide general co-operation and union of forces by the
proletariat. We therefore hope that all those who sympathise
with the objects of this Association, whether teachers, students,
lawyers, doctors, newspapermen, labourers, peasants, philanthro-
pists, literati, merchants or politicians, will join the Asso-
ciation, so that many hands may make light the work of our
national struggle for independence.

3) A list of promoters is given, and from the fact that although
some are Communists others are Moderates opposed to Communism, it is
clear that the intention is to make the organisation representative of
all the progressive parties. Among the promoters in addition to the
names which appear in the list forwarded to S.M.Police are the follow-
ing:-

General YU YU JEN (于右任 ) Principal Director of
the Shanghai University.
TAI CHI TAO (戴季陶 ) who was expelled from the
Kuomintang Executive Committee on account of his
moderation.
KAO YU HAN (高語罕 )
YUN TAI YING (代英 ) and
LIN YI CHING (劉一清 )
all well known Extremists, though probably not members of the Com-
munist Party.
WU SHAN (吳山 ) a Right Wing Kuomintang and one of the
chief movers of the National Road Construction movement.
LIN CHUN (林鈞 ) the prominent student agitator.

4) The resolutions of the "Extended Plenum of the Chinese
Communist Party" held in October 1925, however, thrown an interesting
light on the purposes of the Association for among the resolutions regarding
the formation of the Distress Relief Association appear the following:

"13. The 4th and 5th Congresses of the Communist Inter-
national and the various Plenary Sessions, recognising the need
for forming 'International Relief Associations, specially directed
each branch of the International to establish such an Association
in its own country."

16.
page_data.zh:
-2-

但这不是一些规模小或资源有限的组织所能单独承担的任务，它需要无产阶级的广泛普遍合作和力量联合。因此，我们希望所有同情本协会宗旨的人，无论是教师、学生、律师、医生、新闻工作者、劳工、农民、慈善家、文人、商人还是政治家，都能加入本协会，以便集众人之力，减轻我们争取民族独立斗争的工作负担。

3) 列出了一份发起人名单，从事实来看，虽然其中一些人是共产党员，另一些则是反对共产主义的温和派，显然其意图是使该组织代表所有进步党派。除了发送给上海公共租界警务处的名单上的名字外，发起人中还包括以下人员：

于右任将军 (General YU YU JEN)，上海大学校长。
戴季陶 (TAI CHI TAO)，因其温和立场而被逐出国民党中央执行委员会。
高语罕 (KAO YU HAN)
恽代英 (YUN TAI YING) 和
刘一清 (LIN YI CHING)
均为著名的极端分子，尽管可能不是共产党员。
吴山 (WU SHAN)，国民党右派，全国道路建设运动的主要推动者之一。
林钧 (LIN CHUN)，著名的学生煽动者。

4) 然而，1925年10月举行的“中国共产党扩大全会”的决议，为该协会的目的提供了有趣的线索，因为在关于成立济难会的决议中出现了以下内容：

“13. 共产国际第四次和第五次代表大会及各次全体会议认识到成立‘国际救济协会’的需要，特别指示国际各支部在其本国建立此类协会。”

16.

page_data.en:
-3-

"16. Each party comrade must grasp the fact that this Asso-
ciation is a line of defence of the Red Revolution and is not a
charitable institution. All should join it and forward its --
objects. Though this Association is non-secret and non-party,
its activities must be directed by this party."

5) The Association is closely connected with the "Oppressed
Races of the East" movement in Canton and has in my opinion one of the
most dangerous and successful methods the Bolsheviks have employed in
China hitherto.

6) A similar attempt to popularise the ".O.P.R. movement in
India has been noticed by the Indian Police but is not likely to have
much effect there.

7) Among the local activities in which this Association has been
noticed are:

(1) Attempts to obtain the release of FANG CHING YUN (
), arrested on April 8th by the Chinese Police
as a sort of hostage for the good behaviour of the
General Labour Union during May 30th celebrations.

(2) It took part in the May 30th celebrations but without
distinguishing itself. There was published in the Press
an appeal for subscriptions for the relief of the com-
rades who suffered in Peking disturbances after the
Peking branch had taken a prominent part in those dis-
turbances.

8) Among those elected officers of the Canton branch on March
15th are the well known radicals FANG CHING WEI (汪精衛 ), HO HSIANG
NING (何香凝 ) ( wife of Liao Chung-kai Yao Chun-kai), and CHEN KUNG PO (陳公博 )
Communist chief of the Labour Department of the Canton Government.
page_data.zh:
-3-

“16. 每位党员同志必须认清，该协会是红色革命的防线，而非慈善机构。所有人都应加入并推进其目标。虽然该协会是非秘密、非党派的，但其活动必须由本党指导。”

5) 该协会与广州的“东方被压迫民族”运动密切相关，依我看，这是布尔什维克迄今为止在中国采用的最危险且最成功的方法之一。

6) 印度警方已注意到在印度普及“.O.P.R. 运动”的类似尝试，但在那里不太可能产生太大影响。

7) 在该协会被注意到的本地活动中包括：

(1) 试图释放方景云 (FANG CHING YUN)（原文不清），他于4月8日被中国警方逮捕，作为在五卅庆祝活动期间约束总工会行为的某种人质。

(2) 它参与了五卅庆祝活动，但并未表现出众。媒体上刊登了一份呼吁捐款以救济在北京骚乱中受难同志的启事，此前北京分会在这些骚乱中发挥了突出作用。

8) 在3月15日当选的广州分会职员中，包括著名的激进分子汪精卫 (FANG CHING WEI)、何香凝 (HO HSIANG NING)（廖仲恺之妻）以及陈公博 (CHEN KUNG PO)，后者是广州政府劳工部的共产党负责人。

REPORT ON Book Illustrating Common Origin of Communist and
Anti-British Activities.
Made by C.D.I. Givens Forwarded by DIRECTOR OF CRIMINAL INTELLIGENCE
Sir,
The China Relief Society(中國濟難會), No. 31 San
Foong Li(三丰里), Tien Tung An(天通庵) Road, which is the
most important Communist organization in Shanghai, publishes
a bi-weekly journal called "Enlightment". A copy of the
3rd issue of this journal is attached herewith together with
translation of parts which show that its publishers aim at the
overthrow of the present social and political system of this
country, and are also engaged on anti-British propaganda.
A list of the officers of the China Relief Society is attached
herewith.
As further inquiries are being made about the
origin of this book and the activities of the China Relief
Society, I respectfully request that the contents of this report
be treated as confidential. There, however, is no need for
keeping the matter secret from the British Authorities whose
nationals have been specially singled out for attack.
R

关于一本阐述共产主义活动与反英活动同源的书籍的报告。
由刑事情报主任吉文斯（C.D.I. Givens）呈报

先生，

位于天通庵路三丰里31号的“中国济难会”是上海最重要的共产主义组织，该会出版一份名为《光明》的半月刊。现随函附上该刊第三期的副本，以及部分内容的译文，这些内容显示其出版者旨在推翻本国现行的社会和政治制度，并从事反英宣传。
现随函附上中国济难会职员名单。

鉴于正在对该书的来源及中国济难会的活动进行进一步调查，我恳请将本报告的内容视为机密。然而，对于英国当局而言，由于该国国民被特别列为攻击目标，故无必要对其保密。

R

of "The Enlightenment"(光明), a bi-weekly publication
issued by the China Relief Society.
--------------------------
Page 37.
The Movement towards Enlightenment and the
China Relief Society.
We feel that the modern system of government is far from
perfect. There are countless sinister factors in the present
social organization. We aim at the reformation of all this.
The aspirations for which we stand are liberty, equality and
enlightment. We are dissatisfied with the present political
and social system. Our aim is the establishment of a social
system under which all the citizens will enjoy liberty and
equality. We resent remaining in darkness and we want to
spread enlightenment. I believe that every true member of the
China Relief Society desires to see the achievement of these
laudable aspirations. Members of the China Relief Society who
do not possess these desires should never have joined our
organization. The performance of objectless deeds is irrational.
Page. 41.
9 - How the British Govern India.
England governs India by splitting up the population
into numerous petty rival states, and further deprives them
of the power to resist by promoting unending religious feuds
between the Hindus and Mohammedans. The British Government also
uses military oppression to keep these people under subjection.
Such a policy is called "Divide and Govern". It is the system
whereby British maintain their power in India and all their
colonies. Although the Indians have become slaves, they still
continue their religious quarrels. In the Spring of the present
year the Mohammedans again came into conflict with the Hindus.
The fight resulted in a loss of over 50 dead and 380 wounded.
The revolt was suppressed by a large body of British troops. "Divide

第37页。
启蒙运动与中国济难会。
我们认为现代政府制度远非完美。当前的社会组织中存在无数邪恶因素。我们旨在改革这一切。我们所主张的愿望是自由、平等和启蒙。我们对当前的政治和社会制度感到不满。我们的目标是建立一个所有公民都能享受自由和平等的社会制度。我们憎恶处于黑暗之中，我们希望传播启蒙。我相信每一位真正的中国济难会会员都渴望看到这些崇高愿望的实现。不具备这些愿望的中国济难会会员本不应加入我们的组织。从事无目标的行为是非理性的。
第41页。
9 - 英国如何统治印度。
英国通过将人口分裂成众多相互敌对的小国来统治印度，并通过煽动印度教徒与穆斯林之间无休止的宗教争端，进一步剥夺他们的抵抗能力。英国政府还利用军事压迫使这些人处于臣服地位。这种政策被称为“分而治之”。这是英国在印度及其所有殖民地维持权力的体系。虽然印度人已成为奴隶，但他们仍继续着宗教争吵。今年春天，穆斯林再次与印度教徒发生冲突。战斗导致50多人死亡，380人受伤。叛乱被大批英军镇压。“分而
